Gold Eval — OCR & Extraction Pipelines

Baltimore marriage certificates · 14 labeled pages · 21 fields / page

Three pipelines on identical gold labels. Docling + RapidOCR and Qwen2-VL 2B feed OCR text into the same LangGraph extraction agent; Qwen2.5-VL 7B extracts structured fields zero-shot from the page image (no OCR text, no agent). Field accuracy rises 64.3% → 91.2% (Qwen2.5-VL 7B leads by 26.9 pp). Note the zero-shot model trades a few hallucinated header fields for far fewer missed values.
